author: [deleted]
body:
Given that no skill is involved, it needs to be sped up.

It's too much like a fishing sim right now.

author: DeathTeddy35
body: I've never enjoyed the fishing aspect of the game. That being said I also hate fishing in other video games and in reel life so I may be biased.

author: Zthewolf53
body:
Iirc The dev hates idle games, and strives to make orna to where you cannot idle it at all.

Of all things, fishing is the most common idle related minigame. So they added a bunch of different ways to force you to interact with it. In doing this they more or less turn your mobile phone into a baby and you're the babysitter staring at nothing until it does a minor thing to involve action. Essentially waiting for paint to dry.

author: wisemeat
body: I'd like to see them add a charm or wieldable shell or something that specifically attracts more fish/deters enemy encounters. I don't mind having to wait a little bit between bites, but it can get frustrating when trying to catch a certain amount of fish for a quest and the majority of bites end up being enemy encounters or items. It makes the already time-consuming task feel that much longer. Just gimme the fishies.

author: [deleted]
body:
Yeah, ***something*** about it needs to change but I don't know what. Either speed up the process or make fish a lot more common but otherwise leave as is.

For now I just ignore it completely, and that's a shame. It also isn't helped that I can be on a bridge over water IRL and the game tells me I'm not close enough to water to fish.

author: weirdplacetogoonfire
body: Took me about 25 minutes to complete a daily fishing task yesterday. That's way too much for an activity that I have no actual interest in doing and take no enjoyment from.

body: I agree. We need more actual fish.at least 15/30

body: Let me buy tower keys with coral pls

body: I really need an improvement bearing in mind the fishing guild is the best value for money in my mind for mats and i need coral and fish are the fastest source.

author: Enough-Bike7525
body:
I wish fishing required a bit more skill. Right now, it's basically "cast lure near max, watch TV while waiting for a bite, fight monster/collect loot, then repeat"

It's pretty mindless and dull. Only thing that makes it worth it are those juicy Ascension mats in the Guild store.... But even then....

author: PicklesAndCoorslight
body: It's boring but comes with great rewards!!  I've purchased 80 greater souls for like 700 coral.  Not bad at all!  Also with the fishing hat I'll catching about 70 fish in a half hour.

author: QuoteGiver
body: Agreed, random worthless loot items need to be removed entirely.  Just let it be a bad fish, but at least be a fish.

body: The worst fishing mini game on the market. I suppose it's a nice trade off for an otherwise stellar game.
